title: Precalculus FRQ: Linear Model Interpretation
review_policy: Every generated draft remains private until a teacher reviews, edits, and approves student-facing language.

criteria.name: Model setup
criteria.remediation_activity: Give students two contexts and ask them to define variables, write the linear equation, and label units before solving.

secure.next_step: Keep naming variables and units before substitution.

developing.next_step: Define the variables and write the equation before substituting values.

missing.next_step: Start by identifying the two quantities and what the slope means.

criteria.name: Solving process
criteria.remediation_activity: Use a worked example where students isolate the unknown, check arithmetic, and annotate each algebraic move.

secure.next_step: Continue checking the solved value against the original equation.

developing.next_step: Show the inverse operation used to isolate the unknown and check one substitution.

missing.next_step: Practice solving a one-step linear equation before returning to the context.

criteria.name: Context interpretation
criteria.remediation_activity: Ask students to write one sentence explaining whether the numerical answer is reasonable in context.

secure.next_step: Keep connecting the numerical answer to the original context.

developing.next_step: Add a final sentence explaining what the answer means and include the unit.

missing.next_step: After solving, answer the original question in words with units.
